text: Lab: the ARCHIVE console's screen floats in the middle of the lab window, covering the centre mullion and both panes; it reads as a screen pasted onto the glass rather than mounted on the wall. Standing ~3.5 m back facing the archive console (tick ~11300).

Quarters, facing the desk/bookshelf: the chapter card 'II · The rescue' with the line 'Ines takes the capsule out' is drawn straight over the 3D scene; the small subtitle line sits on top of the coloured book spines and is hard to read (white text, no backing plate).

Quarters porthole: a dark rectangle with hard straight edges sits in the left third of the porthole view (vertical edge, then a horizontal bottom edge about 2/3 down), cutting across the lensed accretion-disk band, which continues below it. Looks like a hard cut/occluder, not blur. Standing ~1.8 m from the porthole, looking slightly left of it; also visible facing it head-on (thin vertical seam inside the porthole).

Quarters: 'E Look out of the porthole' prompt and the orange use-brackets stay on screen while the crosshair is on the bookshelf/wall well to the right of the porthole. The brackets also sit inside the porthole, not where the crosshair is, so it is unclear what E will act on.
